description: This file implements the WidevinePlatformDRM class, providing methods for decryption handling, including constructor, destructor, and decryption proxies that convert handle identifiers to secure memory pointers and invoke the underlying _cdm's decrypt methods.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class providing an interface to handle Widevine DRM decryption operations, including constructor, destructor, and decryption methods that interact with secure memory handles and the underlying CDM.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform DRM object, taking a pointer to a widevine::Cdm instance.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts data associated with a handle and batch, converting the handle to a secure pointer, then calling the CDM decrypt method.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Overloaded method that also takes a session ID alongside the handle and batch, performs handle conversion, and calls the CDM decrypt with session ID.
